name: Slow
definition: -80% Movement Speed

name: Slow
definition: -80% Movement Speed

name: Bind
definition: Unable to move

name: Bind
definition: Unable to move

name: Stun
definition: Unable to move, block, attack, or use skills

name: Stun
definition: Unable to move, block, attack, or use skills

name: Status Resistance
definition: Stun, Cold, and Frozen durations halved; Paralysis loses 1 stack every 5s (does not stack with the same effect)

name: Invisible
definition: Prevents being targeted by enemy attacks if the unit is not blocking

name: Invisible
definition: Prevents being targeted by enemy attacks if the unit is not blocking

name: Camouflage
definition: Prevents being targeted by normal enemy attacks if the unit is not blocking (but will still take Splash damage)

name: Fragile
definition: Amplifies all Physical, Arts, and True damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

name: Shield
definition: Blocks 1 instance of damage per layer of Shield

name: Sanctuary
definition: Reduces incoming Physical and Arts damage by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

name: Cold
definition: Reduces ASPD by 30 and causes subsequent applications of the Cold status during the debuff duration to inflict Frozen

name: Frozen
definition: Unable to move, attack, or use skills (inflicted through the Cold status); When enemies are frozen, RES -15

name: Frozen
definition: Unable to move, attack, or use skills (inflicted through the Cold status); When enemies are frozen, RES -15

name: Sleep
definition: Invulnerable and unable to take any actions

name: Inspiration
definition: Increases base stats (only the strongest effect of this type applies for each stat)

name: Tied
definition: When the corresponding Tied unit is no longer on the battlefield, this unit's skill immediately ends, SP is set to 0, and SP can no longer be gained

name: Nervous Impairment
definition:
Against enemies: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), dealing 6000 Elemental Damage and inflicting 3 stacks of Paralysis. 10s cooldown.
On allies: After Nervous Impairment reaches 1000, the affected unit takes 1000 True damage and is Stunned for 10s

name: Charged
definition: Can continue recovering SP after reaching the maximum. When SP reaches double the maximum, enters Charged state. Skills have additional effects when activated in Charged state (All SP will be consumed whenever the skill is activated)

name: Vigor
definition: Increases stats when HP is above a certain percentage (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

name: Corrosion
definition:
Against enemies: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), dealing 5000 Elemental Damage and permanently reducing DEF by 120 (stacks). 8s cooldown.
On allies: After Corrosion reaches 1000, the affected unit has its DEF permanently reduced by 100 and takes 800 Physical damage

name: Burn
definition:
Against enemies: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), dealing 7000 Elemental Damage and temporarily inflicting -20 RES. 10s cooldown.
On allies: After Burn reaches 1000, the affected unit has its RES reduced by 20 for 10 seconds and takes 1200 Arts damage

name: Low-Altitude Hovering
definition: Cannot be blocked or attacked by melee attacks

name: Refraction
definition: When in effect, RES +70

name: Elemental Injury
definition: Includes Nervous Impairment, Corrosion, Burn, and Necrosis

name: Overload
definition: Skill duration has two gauges. Extra effect is triggered when skill duration is halfway complete.

name: Necrosis
definition:
Against enemies: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), inflicting 50%Enfeeble that gradually recovers, and dealing 800 Elemental Damage per second. 15s cooldown.
On allies: After Necrosis reaches 1000, the affected unit cannot use skills for 15 seconds and every second loses 1 SP and takes 100 Arts damage

name: Negative Status
definition: Includes Stun, Cold, Freeze, etc.

name: Levitate
definition: Target becomes aerial and cannot move, attack, or use skills. Duration halved if Weight is greater than 3.

name: Physical Shield
definition: Blocks 1 instance of Physical damage per layer of Physical Shield

name: Arts Fragility
definition: Amplifies all Arts damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

name: Elemental Fragility
definition: Amplifies all Elemental Damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

name: Critically Wounded
definition: Movement Speed reduced, cannot be blocked, dies after 10s, restores SP to the attacker when defeated.

name: Barrier
definition: Absorbs a certain amount of damage.

name: Weightless
definition: Weight reduced by 1 level (effects of the same name do not stack)

name: Tenacity
definition: Increases stats proportionally based on lost HP, reaching the maximum bonus once a certain percentage has been lost (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

name: Steal
definition: Reduces the target's base stats while increasing own. The reduction and increase in stats cannot exceed the specified upper limit (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

name: Enfeeble
definition: Reduces the target's ATK by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect with this name applies)

name: Protective Barrier
definition: Absorbs a certain amount of Elemental Injury.

name: Frighten
definition: Cannot perform normal attacks when blocked

name: Fear
definition: Cannot be blocked and runs off uncontrollably

name: Move
definition: Cannot leave the field; will deploy at the target location with the current HP

name: Mana
definition: A special form of SP that persists throughout battle

name: Chanting
definition: Stops attacking for a period of time, then attempts to activate skill; interruptions during this period will stop the chant

name: Laios's Party
definition: Includes Marcille, Senshi, Laios, and Chilchuck

name: Take Off
definition: Cannot block ground enemies and will not be attacked by them; can block flying enemies

name: Physical Fragility
definition: Amplifies all Physical damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

name: Paralysis
definition: Each stack of Paralysis can interrupt an enemy when it attempts to perform a normal attack, max 3 stacks; Paralysis has unlimited duration when not consumed, but units with status resistance lose 1 stack every 5s

name: Replenish
definition: Replenishes ammo for other Operators' ammo-type skills; an ammo-type skill can only be replenished up to its max ammo capacity during a single activation of that skill

name: Lure
definition: Cannot be blocked and moves towards the target's position

name: Continuously Attack
definition: Continuously attacks, regardless of whether there is a target within Attack Range

name: Fever
definition: Once Fever reaches 450, whenever any Ave Mujica member's skill is manually activated, all Ave Mujica members on the field will keep their current skill activated for 20s

name: Ave Mujica
definition: Includes Sakiko Togawa, Umiri Yahata, Uika Misumi, Nyamu Yūtenji, Mutsumi Wakaba

name: Equipment Alteration
definition: When selecting a deployed Operator, can activate extra effects when certain conditions are fulfilled

name: Weakness damage
definition: When dealing Physical or Arts damage, changes damage type depending on the target's DEF and RES

name: Damage Reduction
definition: Reduces incoming damage by a fixed amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

name: Sluggish
definition: Movement Speed, ASPD, activation and cooldown speed of certain skills, and recovery speed from certain negative statuses are reduced by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

name: DP Lower Limit
definition: DP can drop below the DP Lower Limit; when DP is below 0, natural DP regeneration rate -50%
